title: NB Perfect Pack
description: a modpack that makes me enjoy mc
body: I put this modpack together to make Minecraft look and feel the exact way I like it. It keeps the core vanilla game completely intact, but massively overhauls the performance, updates the animations, and polishes the visuals to be super clean and responsive. It’s hyper optimized, looks amazing, and just makes the entire experience way more immersive without losing that classic blocky vibe. If you want a smooth, modern, and refined vanilla+ experience, this is it!
